candidates.label: Quran as Book bringing humanity from darkness to light
candidates.definition: In 14:1: A Book We revealed to you that you might bring mankind out of darknesses into the light by permission of their Lord.

evidence.excerpt: الٓرۚ كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَيۡكَ لِتُخۡرِجَ ٱلنَّاسَ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِمۡ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَمِيدِ

existingTopicOverlap.note: Min al-zulumat ila al-nur as Quranic function.

candidates.label: Prophetic mission in native language ensuring clarity
candidates.definition: In 14:4: We did not send any messenger except in the language of his people to state clearly for them.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا بِلِسَانِ قَوۡمِهِۦ لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمۡۖ فَيُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِي مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

candidates.label: Gratitude-ingratitude principle as divine law of increase and punishment
candidates.definition: In 14:7: Your Lord proclaimed if you are grateful I will surely increase you but if you deny indeed My punishment is severe.

evidence.excerpt: وَإِذۡ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكُمۡ لَئِن شَكَرۡتُمۡ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمۡۖ وَلَئِن كَفَرۡتُمۡ إِنَّ عَذَابِي لَشَدِيدٞ

existingTopicOverlap.note: La'in shakartum la'azidannakum as conditional divine law.

candidates.label: Messenger humanity affirmed while divine favor distinguished
candidates.definition: In 14:11: Their messengers said we are only men like you but Allah confers favor upon whom He wills of His servants.

evidence.excerpt: قَالَتۡ لَهُمۡ رُسُلُهُمۡ إِن نَّحۡنُ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَمُنُّ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦۖ وَمَا كَانَ لَنَآ أَن نَّأۡتِيَكُم بِسُلۡطَٰنٍ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ

candidates.label: Historical destruction pattern through Nuh Aad Thamud sequence
candidates.definition: In 14:9: Has there not reached you news of those before you people of Nuh and Aad and Thamud and those after them? None knows them except Allah.

evidence.excerpt: أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ نَبَؤُاْ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِكُمۡ قَوۡمِ نُوحٖ وَعَادٖ وَثَمُودَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُهُمۡ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُۚ جَآءَتۡهُمۡ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَرَدُّوٓاْ أَيۡدِيَهُمۡ فِيٓ أَفۡوَٰهِهِمۡ وَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا كَفَرۡنَا بِمَآ أُرۡسِلۡتُم بِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَفِي شَكّٖ مِّمَّا تَدۡعُونَنَآ إِلَيۡهِ مُرِيبٖ

candidates.label: Disbelief metaphor as ashes scattered by storm wind
candidates.definition: In 14:18: Example of those who disbelieve their deeds are like ashes which wind blows forcefully on stormy day unable to keep anything earned.

evidence.excerpt: مَّثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِرَبِّهِمۡۖ أَعۡمَٰلُهُمۡ كَرَمَادٍ ٱشۡتَدَّتۡ بِهِ ٱلرِّيحُ فِي يَوۡمٍ عَاصِفٖۖ لَّا يَقۡدِرُونَ مِمَّا كَسَبُواْ عَلَىٰ شَيۡءٖۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلضَّلَٰلُ ٱلۡبَعِيدُ

candidates.label: Good word-good tree parable with firm root and perpetual fruit
candidates.definition: In 14:24-25: Allah presents example good word like good tree root firmly fixed branches in sky producing fruit all the time by permission of its Lord.

evidence.excerpt: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا كَلِمَةٗ طَيِّبَةٗ كَشَجَرَةٖ طَيِّبَةٍ أَصۡلُهَا ثَابِتٞ وَفَرۡعُهَا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ

candidates.label: Bad word-bad tree uprooted without stability
candidates.definition: In 14:26: Example of bad word like bad tree uprooted from surface of earth having no stability.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَثَلُ كَلِمَةٍ خَبِيثَةٖ كَشَجَرَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍ ٱجۡتُثَّتۡ مِن فَوۡقِ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مَا لَهَا مِن قَرَارٖ

candidates.label: Divine firmness for believers through steadfast word in both worlds
candidates.definition: In 14:27: Allah keeps firm those who believe with the firm word in worldly life and Hereafter; Allah sends astray wrongdoers.

evidence.excerpt: يُثَبِّتُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ ٱلثَّابِتِ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَفِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ وَيُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَۚ وَيَفۡعَلُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ

candidates.label: Satan's post-judgment confession of powerlessness
candidates.definition: In 14:22: Satan says when matter concluded Allah promised you promise of truth I promised but betrayed you had no authority over you except invitation.

evidence.excerpt: وَقَالَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ لَمَّا قُضِيَ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَعَدَكُمۡ وَعۡدَ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَوَعَدتُّكُمۡ فَأَخۡلَفۡتُكُمۡۖ وَمَا كَانَ لِيَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّن سُلۡطَٰنٍ إِلَّآ أَن دَعَوۡتُكُمۡ فَٱسۡتَجَبۡتُمۡ لِيۖ فَلَا تَلُومُونِي وَلُومُوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۖ مَّآ أَنَا۠ بِمُصۡرِخِكُمۡ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُصۡرِخِيَّ إِنِّي كَفَرۡتُ بِمَآ أَشۡرَكۡتُمُونِ مِن قَبۡلُۗ إِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ

existingTopicOverlap.note: Individual responsibility confirmed by enemy testimony.

candidates.label: Favor-for-disbelief exchange resulting in hellish settlement
candidates.definition: In 14:28-29: Those who exchanged favor of Allah for disbelief and settled their people in home of ruin — Hell which they burn wretched settlement.

evidence.excerpt: ۞أَلَمۡ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ بَدَّلُواْ نِعۡمَتَ ٱللَّهِ كُفۡرٗا وَأَحَلُّواْ قَوۡمَهُمۡ دَارَ ٱلۡبَوَارِ

candidates.label: Prayer-spending command as believer identity before tradeless Day
candidates.definition: In 14:31: Tell My servants who believed establish prayer spend from what We provided secretly publicly before Day no trade nor friendship.

evidence.excerpt: قُل لِّعِبَادِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يُقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُنفِقُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ سِرّٗا وَعَلَانِيَةٗ مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَ يَوۡمٞ لَّا بَيۡعٞ فِيهِ وَلَا خِلَٰلٌ

candidates.label: Uncountable divine favors contrasted with human ingratitude
candidates.definition: In 14:34: He gave you from all you asked; if you count favor of Allah you cannot enumerate it; indeed mankind is most unjust ungrateful.

evidence.excerpt: وَءَاتَىٰكُم مِّن كُلِّ مَا سَأَلۡتُمُوهُۚ وَإِن تَعُدُّواْ نِعۡمَتَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحۡصُوهَآۗ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَظَلُومٞ كَفَّارٞ

candidates.label: Abraham's Mecca supplication for security and monotheism
candidates.definition: In 14:35-37: Abraham said My Lord make this city secure keep me and sons from worshipping idols; settled descendants in uncultivated valley near sacred House to establish prayer.

evidence.excerpt: وَإِذۡ قَالَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمُ رَبِّ ٱجۡعَلۡ هَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدَ ءَامِنٗا وَٱجۡنُبۡنِي وَبَنِيَّ أَن نَّعۡبُدَ ٱلۡأَصۡنَامَ

existingTopicOverlap.note: Model dua combining temporal and spiritual requests.
Protection from shirk as primary concern.

candidates.label: Intercessory prayer for parents and all believers on Judgment Day
candidates.definition: In 14:41: Our Lord forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.

evidence.excerpt: رَبَّنَا ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلۡحِسَابُ

candidates.label: Wrongdoer delusion exposed through delayed punishment
candidates.definition: In 14:42-44: Never think Allah unaware of wrongdoers He delays them for Day eyes stare horror; they say our Lord delay us brief term.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَا تَحۡسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَٰفِلًا عَمَّا يَعۡمَلُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَۚ إِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمۡ لِيَوۡمٖ تَشۡخَصُ فِيهِ ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرُ

candidates.label: Earth-heaven replacement as cosmic transformation on Judgment Day
candidates.definition: In 14:48: On Day earth replaced by another earth and heavens all creatures come out before Allah One Prevailing.

evidence.excerpt: يَوۡمَ تُبَدَّلُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ غَيۡرَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُۖ وَبَرَزُواْ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡوَٰحِدِ ٱلۡقَهَّارِ

candidates.label: Criminal binding and pitch-garment punishment imagery
candidates.definition: In 14:49-50: You see criminals that Day bound together in shackles their garments of liquid pitch faces covered by Fire.

evidence.excerpt: وَتَرَى ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ يَوۡمَئِذٖ مُّقَرَّنِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَصۡفَادِ

existingTopicOverlap.note: Qatran garments and facial fire coverage.

candidates.label: Creation-provision catalog demonstrating uncountable favors
candidates.definition: In 14:32-33: Allah created heavens earth sent rain produced fruits subjected sun moon continuous night day ships rivers.

evidence.excerpt: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَخۡرَجَ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ رِزۡقٗا لَّكُمۡۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡفُلۡكَ لِتَجۡرِيَ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ بِأَمۡرِهِۦۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرَ

candidates.label: Closing tawheed affirmation and mindfulness command
candidates.definition: In 14:52: This is notification for people warned thereby know He is one God and people of understanding reminded.

evidence.excerpt: هَٰذَا بَلَٰغٞ لِّلنَّاسِ وَلِيُنذَرُواْ بِهِۦ وَلِيَعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞ وَلِيَذَّكَّرَ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
